overlaidText.benchmarks/pubspec.yaml:
name: benchmarks
description: A benchmark app for Levit.
publish_to: 'none'
version: 1.0.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ^3.12.0
  flutter: '>=3.44.0'

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  
  # Local Levit packages
  levit_flutter: ^0.1.0
  levit_monitor: ^0.1.0
    
  # Comparison frameworks
  provider: ^6.1.1
  get: ^4.6.6
  flutter_bloc: ^9.1.1
  flutter_riverpod: ^2.6.1
  
  # UI & Utils
  fl_chart: ^1.1.1
  gap: ^3.0.0
  rxdart: ^0.28.0
  riverpod: ^2.6.1

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^3.0.0

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true
overlaidText.benchmarks/pubspec_overrides.yaml:
